title: This Dragonfly Weighs 300 Milligrams and Crosses an Ocean

scenes.text: This dragonfly weighs almost nothing, and it crosses an ocean.
It's the globe skimmer. It weighs about three hundred milligrams, less than a paper clip.
Scientists now think it crosses the Indian Ocean from India to Africa and back.
That includes about two thousand kilometers of open sea, with nowhere to land.
It rides the monsoon winds to save its strength.
It's one of the longest insect migrations ever recorded.
